static_traits.name: Yao Moli
static_traits.family_status: Living alone于拉斯维加斯（内华达州）
static_traits.social_status: 与同行关系因频繁比较而紧张；有少量同行可交流，但尚not yet向他们分享自己的压力与Sense of guilt
static_traits.medical_history: without明显身体疾病；without既往心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, highly cooperative, neutral tone; frequent 'should' sentences, harsh demands on herself

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直感到巨大的压力，为了被认为是“模范教练”，需要过度训练。这种压力和not切实际的期待是在我开始将自己与行业内其他教练比较之后出现的。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些压力和内疚正在影响我的心理健康，导致Anxiety并影响我的Work表现。
growth_experiences: 约一年前在新Work环境中，行业竞争突然加剧，来访者开始持续地将自己与其他教练进行比较，认为需要“赶上或超越他们的标准”才算称职。随着时间推移，这种比较引发了高强度压力与not切实际的自我Demands（如设定每天三次、每周七天的训练标准），周末without法放松且伴随显著内疚，压力几乎每天While at work段出现；为缓解压力曾尝试增加训练频率与强度，但not yet获得缓解，反而更疲惫、Anxiety，Decline in work performance，休闲爱好（如钓鱼）被打断，与同事的关系也因持续比较而变得紧张。

core_beliefs: I must be perfect to have value
My value depends on others' evaluations（是否被视为“模范教练”）

special_situations.event: When working alongside other coaches or seeing their performance, comparison arises
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到同行的标准或体型，我就是not合格的教练
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 强行增加训练频率和强度，以证明自己not比do not人差
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must work at least as hard as them, otherwise I am a bad coach

special_situations.event: 周末尝试休息但have not训练时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not持续训练，就是懒惰和失败，会被认为not专业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using guilt to drive myself to re-engage in training, giving up leisure and hobbies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not该休息；我应该去训练

special_situations.event: Facing competition and performance pressure from a new job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我notnot断加码训练，Work表现会崩塌，我会被淘汰
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles training to gain a sense of control, trying to avoid the worst case by working harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我not更努力，一切都会变得很糟

special_situations.event: Thinking of the standard 'in order to be seen as a model coach, I need to train three times a day, seven days a week'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching an extreme training frequency counts as an excellent coach
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 按极端标准安排训练日程，not给自己休息空间
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: To be considered a model coach, I must train three times a day, seven days a week

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, seen as excellent and professional (becoming a 'model coach')
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被淘汰或被视为not称职，担心一旦放松就会“失控、崩塌”
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and avoids negative evaluation through self-blame and high-intensity training

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、需要not断加压才配得上的从业者
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh judge (peers and industry standards)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to reduce training or try resting on weekends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识将休息理解为“失败与not专业”，担心放松会导致Work崩塌（移情：将内在批判投向外界规则）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气坚定但not攻击，用规则化语言为持续训练辩护，如“行业竞争很激烈，我必须坚持”。若被进一步探问，转而强调数据或他人标准以避免触及情绪。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing colleagues' performance at work and making comparisons
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身not安全感Projection为他人的外在评判与行业标准，认为他人会视自己为not称职（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use小心谨慎的语气，避免直接表达自卑，改以“他们都很强，我必须跟上”来隐蔽情绪；减少停顿，快速转向行动计划以避开内在感受。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about needing to be 'recognized as a model coach' by others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses external recognition as the main source of self-worth, tying self-worth to others' evaluation (transference: identification with the external object)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气严谨，频繁use“应该/必须”等绝对化词汇，强调遵循行业标准以获得安全感，回避对自身感受的探讨。

manifestations: Restricts self-choice with external standards and 'should' sentence patterns (such as setting extreme training frequency)
周末难以Freedom休息，Sense of guilt主导行为
Ties self-worth to industry recognition, sacrificing personal will and pace
outcomes: Rigid behavior patterns and harsh self-criticism
休闲与兴趣（如钓鱼）被剥夺，主观Decline in sense of well-being

manifestations: Living alone于拉斯维加斯，生活支持有限
与同行Relationship tension、疏离，较少情感连接
虽有少量同行可交流，但并not yet分享真实压力与Sense of guilt
outcomes: Increased emotional burden，缺乏关系支持的缓冲
Worsening self-comparison and reliance on external evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“应该/必须”句式（如“To be considered a model coach, I must train three times a day, seven days a week”）
Uses industry competition and others' standards as the sole basis for judgment, ignoring own reality and feelings
Treating rest as a mistake or failure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 高度自我苛责，担心“not努力就会一切崩塌”
对尝试not同做法持谨慎态度，害怕后果
In sessions, first emphasizes how to 'work harder', avoiding exploring emotional needs

positive_force: Has the willingness for self-observation and recording (willing to use a diary to track thoughts and emotions)
Willing to try new methods, cautiously optimistic about change
有一定的同行资源可潜在支持（虽not yetuse）
negative_force: Strong dependence on external recognition and persistent comparison with others
灾难化Anticipation（担心not加码训练就会“一切崩塌”）
Rest triggers strong guilt, leading to overtraining and exhaustion
not yet有效useSocial support，Relationship estrangement加重压力

target_behavior.behavior: 过度训练及在not yet训练时产生Strong guilt与Anxiety
antecedent: Seeing or thinking of other coaches' performance at work and comparing
周末或休息时段not yet训练
Increased competition and performance pressure after the new job
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection的行业规则与“应该”句式驱动、将自我价值与外部评价绑定、对not加码训练的灾难化Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 逃避“not被认可/not称职”的Anxiety，获取掌控感与外部认可
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、Physical and mental exhaustion加重、Tense relationships with colleagues、休闲与爱好被中断
